name: Fix MainMenu - List all apps & add single view routes
description:
## MainMenu Issues

### Issue: App List & Routing

#### Current State
- MainMenu may not list all available apps
- Missing or incomplete routes for single app view
- Desktop view may be interfering with single view routing

#### Requirements
- [ ] List ALL apps available in the system
- [ ] Ensure each app has a dedicated single view route
- [ ] Remove or deprioritize desktop view
- [ ] Maintain app navigation consistency

#### App Discovery & Routes
- [ ] Audit current app list in MainMenu
- [ ] Verify all apps have corresponding single-view routes
- [ ] Create missing routes as needed
- [ ] Update MainMenu to display all apps
- [ ] Test navigation to each single-view app

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ All apps listed in MainMenu
- ✅ Each app has working single-view route
- ✅ No desktop-only apps blocking single view access
- ✅ Navigation between apps works smoothly
- ✅ Routes are RESTful and consistent
